scenarios.title: A private session booked for SIX carries the count on the order; the price is unchanged, quantity is 1

checks.desc: the price is the item price (£50), unchanged by the count
it is one booking (quantity 1), not six
a second private session for TWO carries attendees = 2
and the SAME price (£50) — the head count never touches price

scenarios.title: The provider sees the head count on their orders

checks.desc: the provider’s orders feed returns the 10:00 booking

scenarios.title: The cap is honest per shape: a small studio (capacity 4) binds at 4; a traveller (no capacity) binds at the cottage (6)

checks.desc: a come-to-me studio of capacity 4 clamps an over-ask (99) to 4
a travelling provider (no capacity) clamps the same over-ask to the cottage’s 6
